brief: Fujii, Hyperbolic 3-manifolds with totally geodesic boundary (Osaka J. Math. 27(3), 1990, 539–553).
extended:
**Hyperbolic 3-manifolds with totally geodesic boundary** — Michihiko Fujii. Osaka Journal of Mathematics 27(3), 1990, 539–553. DOI 10.18910/11468.

**Why it may bear here.** Geodesic-boundary hyperbolic 3-manifolds are the setting of the Frigerio deformation result (frigerio2006) also held, and of the fundamental-shadow-link complements this corpus uses. Distinct from fujii1992 (Kodai Math. J. 15, 244–257), a different paper by the same author also in the library.
